authorization.basis: Owner-approved End-to-End Programmatic Execution Plan for P00/G0 (2026-11-01)
authorization.mode: source-and-document-only; automatic phases A,B,C,E,F,H; owner gates D,G,I,closure
authorization.note: No target access, credentials, custody acts, configuration, provisioning, implementation, tests, qualification execution or deployment are authorized under this plan.

d8_rev03.role: stable D8 input candidate for precondition B.7.4

baseline.rules: Any byte change to either digest-bound artifact voids its binding and requires re-issue.

preserved_rules: AI review is not independent human custody
external human acceptor remains an unselected option
acceptance authority and evidence destination undesignated
prior unauthorized inspection unverified and excluded
weaker-assurance baseline is historical reference only
INCOMPLETE = evidence exists but insufficient/unauthenticated/unsafe to conclude
a stopped attempt is not a completed campaign
confirmed failure remains visible and is never erased
redaction uncertainty => INCOMPLETE, never a pass
no retry with broader access after a stop condition
no credentials, raw unexpected values, SQL/script bodies, user identities, document identifiers, or unrelated business records may be collected

phases.name: Technical continuation plan
acceptance_checks: every evidence class, control, stop and prerequisite enumerated
dependencies, outputs, acceptance checks and stop conditions present

phases.name: Evidence-package design
acceptance_checks: each defines purpose, inputs, procedure, expected evidence, redaction rules, failure/stop conditions, status mapping, required artifacts, qualification criteria

phases.name: Custody and acceptance options
acceptance_checks: eight areas covered with options and tradeoffs

phases.name: Owner business gate 1 (custody/destination/authority/retention)
acceptance_checks: packet presents options, tradeoffs, no selection
phases.stop: No directory creation, permission change, backup configuration or custody act until separately authorized.

phases.name: Qualification-proof plan
acceptance_checks: verified against D8 REV_03, spec REV_02, selected custody arrangement, preserved rules

phases.name: Feasibility verdict
acceptance_checks: verdict one of FEASIBLE_WITH_EXISTING_AUTHORIZATION | FEASIBLE_WITH_NEW_AUTHORIZATION | NOT_FEASIBLE_UNDER_CURRENT_RULES

phases.name: Owner business gate 2 (execution authorization if needed)
outputs: owner decision packet with scope, target/environment/principal/mechanism/destination, stops, rollback, exact wording
acceptance_checks: no execution beyond source-and-document-only without explicit owner authorization

phases.name: Qualification execution
outputs: redacted execution records if separately authorized
acceptance_checks: approved principal, mechanism, destination, scope only
no conversion of uncertainty to pass

phases.name: Evidence review and closure
acceptance_checks: MiMo verifies completeness, redaction, statuses, provenance, governance, boundaries
gate remains BLOCKED unless closure criteria met and owner accepts closure

evidence_classes.name: Redaction-method qualification
required_artifacts: adversarial test evidence only under future separate grant

evidence_classes.name: Independent package review
required_artifacts: technical author/reviewer separation review record (not custody, not acceptance)

stop_conditions.condition: correlation invalidated (reconnect, handle reuse, restart, pool switch)
freshness unprovable or surface visibility uncharacterized
method unqualified or proof evidence incomplete
integrity-chain break (record or digest-bound design inputs)
stop_conditions.status: FAIL where safe; INCOMPLETE on leak risk; provenance-context verification failures governed separately (UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE)

stop_conditions.condition: need for configuration change/write attempt/target access/identity collection/provisioning/testing
stop_conditions.status: stop; INCOMPLETE if evidence exists but scope cannot proceed, else UNKNOWN

stop_conditions.condition: output value not expressible in closed vocabularies

prerequisites.name: non-mutation proof for the read path
D8 qualification of comparison method (identity proof + fixed classes)
redaction-method qualification and safe-failure record design
governance decisions first (acceptance authority, integrity destination, conflict checks)

owner_gates.decision: evidence destination, custody-acceptance process, acceptance authority, retention/recovery
owner_gates.blocking: no directory creation/permission/backup/custody act before separate authorization

owner_gates.decision: execution authorization if feasibility verdict requires it

owner_gates.blocking: no live execution without explicit owner authorization
gate remains BLOCKED unless closure criteria met and owner separately accepts

verification.role: independent technical verification (not independent human custody, not acceptance)
